rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Youth Protection and Environment Division ), 02-2100-6292

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「청소년 보호법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Youth Protection Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(청소년유해매체물 등의 고시) 「청소년 보호법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제3호ㆍ제4호 및 제5호에 따른 청소년유해매체물ㆍ청소년유해약물등 및 청소년유해업소의 고시는 관보에 게재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Notification of Media Harmful to Youth, etc.) Notifications of media harmful to youth, drugs harmful to youth, etc., and establishments harmful to youth pursuant to Article 2, subparagraphs 3, 4, and 5 of the Youth Protection Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall be published in the Official Gazette.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(청소년유해매체물 결정 신청서) 법 제7조 및 「청소년 보호법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제7조제3항에 따라 매체물을 청소년유해매체물로 결정하여 줄 것을 신청하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 청소년유해매체물 결정 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류 등을 첨부하여 법 제36조에 따른 청소년보호위원회(이하 “청소년보호위원회”라 한다) 또는 법 제7조제1항 단서의 다른 법령에 따라 해당 매체물의 윤리성ㆍ건전성을 심의할 수 있는 기관(이하 “각 심의기관”이라 한다)에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Determination of Media Harmful to Youth) Any person who intends to apply for a determination that media are harmful to youth pursuant to Article 7 of the Act and Article 7(3) of the Enforcement Decree of the Youth Protection Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an Application for Determination of Media Harmful to Youth in the form of Attached Form No. 1, together with the following documents, to the Youth Protection Committee under Article 36 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Youth Protection Committee”) or to an institution authorized under other statutes to deliberate on the ethics and soundness of the relevant media pursuant to the proviso to Article 7(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an “individual deliberative institution”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 매체물이 청소년에게 유해하다고 인정되는 사유를 기재한 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents stating the reasons why the media is deemed harmful to adolescents
2. The relevant media

rows.source_ko: 3. 30명 이상의 서명을 받은 서면(영 제7조제3항제2호에 해당하는 자만 첨부한다)
rows.text_en: 3. A written document signed by 30 or more people ( attached only by persons falling under Article 7, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree)

rows.source_ko: 제4조(청소년 유해 여부 확인 신청서) 법 제11조제1항에 따라 매체물제작자ㆍ발행자, 유통행위자 또는 매체물과 관련된 단체(이하 “자율규제단체등”이라 한다)가 청소년보호위원회 또는 각 심의기관에 매체물에 대한 청소년 유해 여부의 확인을 요청하려는 경우에는 별지 제2호서식의 청소년 유해 여부 확인 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류 및 매체물을 첨부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Confirmation of Harm to Youth) In accordance with Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act , if a media producer, publisher, distributor, or organization related to media (hereinafter referred to as “self-regulatory organization, etc.”) intends to request confirmation of whether a media is harmful to youth from the Youth Protection Committee or each deliberation body, they shall attach the documents and media specified in each of the following subparagraphs to the Application for Confirmation of Harm to Youth in the form of Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: 1. 자율규제단체등이 청소년 유해 여부를 결정한 내용을 기재한 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents stating the determination by self-regulatory organizations, etc., regarding whether it is harmful to youth
2. The media for which verification is requested

rows.source_ko: 제5조(청소년유해매체물 재심의 청구 및 결정 등) ① 법 제12조제1항에 따라 재심의를 청구하려는 자는 별지 제3호서식의 청소년유해매체물 재심의 청구서를 청소년보호위원회에 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Request for Reconsideration and Decision on Media Harmful to Youth, etc.) ①Any person who wishes to request reconsideration pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit a request for reconsideration of media harmful to youth in the form of Annex 3 to the Youth Protection Committee.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 재심의를 청구한 자는 청소년보호위원회의 재심의를 위한 회의에 출석하여 의견을 진술할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has requested a reconsideration pursuant to Paragraph 1 may attend a meeting of the Youth Protection Committee for reconsideration and state their opinion.

rows.source_ko: ③ 청소년보호위원회는 재심의하여 결정한 결과를 재심의를 청구한 자에게 서면으로 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Youth Protection Committee shall notify the person who requested the reconsideration of the results of the decision made after reconsideration in writing.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(청소년유해매체물의 결정 취소) 청소년보호위원회 및 각 심의기관이 법 제20조에 따라 청소년유해매체물의 결정을 취소한 경우 성평등가족부장관은 지체 없이 그 이유를 명시한 서면으로 영 제12조에 따른 청소년유해표시 의무자와 영 제14조제2항에 따른 포장 의무자에게 그 사실을 통보하고, 관보에 고시하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Cancellation of Decision on Media Harmful to Youth) Where the Youth Protection Committee and each deliberative bodycancel a decision on media harmful to youth pursuant to Article 20 of the Act , the Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall, without delay, notify the persons obligated to display the warning label under Article 12 of the Enforcement Decree and the persons obligated to provide packaging under Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of such fact in writing specifying the reasons, and shall publish the notice in the Official Gazette. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(청소년유해매체물 목록표의 작성ㆍ통보) ① 성평등가족부장관은 법 제21조제2항에 따라 별지 제4호서식부터 별지 제8호서식까지의 청소년유해매체물 목록표를 작성하여 관보에 고시하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Preparation and Notification of List of Media Harmful to Youth) ① The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall,pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Act , prepare the List of Media Harmful to Youth in the form of Annex No. 4 through Annex No. 8 and publish it in the Official Gazette. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제21조제3항에 따라 성평등가족부장관이 청소년유해매체물 목록표를 통보하여야 하는 관계기관등은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The relevant agencies, etc. to which the Minister of Gender Equality and Family is to notify the list of media harmful to youth pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(청소년유해약물등 목록표의 작성ㆍ통보) ① 성평등가족부장관은 법 제28조제6항에 따라 별지 제9호서식의 청소년유해약물 목록표와 별지 제10호서식의 청소년유해물건 목록표를 작성하여 관보에 고시하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 3. 10., 2020. 6. 25., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Preparation and Notification of List of Drugs, etc. Harmful to Youth) ① The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall,pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 6 of the Act , prepare the List of Drugs Harmful to Youth in Form No. 9 of the Attached Form and the List of Objects Harmful to Youth in Form No. 10 of the Attached Form , and publish them in the Official Gazette . <Amended Mar. 10, 2015; Jun. 25, 2020; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제28조제6항에 따라 성평등가족부장관이 청소년유해약물등 목록표를 통보하여야 하는 관계기관등은 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2015. 3. 10., 2020. 6. 25., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The relevant agencies, etc. to which the Minister of Gender Equality and Family is required to notify the list of substances, etc. harmful to youth pursuant to Article 28 , Paragraph 6 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 2. <Amended Mar. 10, 2015; Jun. 25, 2020; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(청소년 환각물질 중독 전문 치료기관 지정신청서 등) ① 영 제31조의2제3항에 따른 청소년 환각물질 중독 전문 치료기관 지정신청서는 별지 제10호의2서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Application for Designation of Specialized Treatment Institution for Youth Addiction to Hallucinogenic Substances, etc.) ①The application for designation of a specialized treatment institution for youth addiction to hallucinogenic substances pursuant to Article 31-2, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10-2 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제31조의2제4항에 따른 청소년 환각물질 중독 전문 치료기관 지정서는 별지 제10호의3서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The designation certificate for a specialized treatment institution for adolescent hallucinogenic substance addiction pursuant to Article 31-2, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10-3 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted May 29, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의3(환각물질 중독 판별 검사 신청서) 영 제31조의4제2항에 따른 환각물질 중독 판별 검사 신청서는 별지 제10호의4서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-3 (Application for Examination for Identification of Hallucinogenic Substance Addiction) The application for examination for identification of hallucinogenic substance addiction pursuant to Article 31-4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10-4 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted May 29, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의4(환각물질 중독 치료 및 재활 신청서 등) ① 영 제31조의5제2항에 따른 환각물질 중독 치료 및 재활 신청서는 별지 제10호의4서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 8-4 (Application for Treatment and Rehabilitation of Hallucinogenic Substance Addiction, etc.) ①The application for treatment and rehabilitation of hallucinogenic substance addiction pursuant to Article 31-5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10-4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제31조의5제8항에 따른 환각물질 중독 치료 및 재활 기간 연장 요청서는 별지 제10호의5서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The request form for extension of the treatment and rehabilitation period for hallucinogenic substance addiction pursuant to Article 31-5, Paragraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10-5 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted May 29, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제8조의5(청소년의 유해환경에 대한 접촉실태 조사 실시 등) ① 성평등가족부장관은 법 제33조제4항에 따라 청소년의 유해환경에 대한 접촉실태 조사를 2년마다 실시하여야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-5 (Conduct of Survey on Youth's Exposure to Harmful Environments, etc.) ① The Minister of Gender Equality and Family shall conduct a survey on the status of youth's exposure to harmful environments every two years pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 4 of the Act . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 접촉실태 조사에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하여야 한다 <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The investigation into the status of contact pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall include the following matters: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Matters concerning the actual status of youth exposure to harmful media
2. Matters concerning the actual status of youth contact with harmful drugs, etc.
3. Matters concerning the actual status of contact with establishments harmful to youth

rows.source_ko: 4. 청소년 대상 유해행위 실태에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the actual status of harmful acts against youth
5. Matters concerning the employment status of youth

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 청소년 보호와 관련하여 성평등가족부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family in relation to the protection of youth

rows.source_ko: ③ 성평등가족부장관은 제1항에 따라 실시한 접촉실태 조사 결과를 「공공기관의 정보공개에 관한 법률」에 따라 여성가족부의 인터넷 홈페이지 등을 통하여 공개할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Gender Equality and Family may disclose the results of the contact status survey conducted pursuant to Paragraph 1 through the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family’s website, etc., in accordance with the Act on Disclosure of Information by Public Institutions . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2018]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(민간의 감시ㆍ고발 단체) ① 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)은 법 제48조제1항 및 영 제40조에 따라 청소년유해환경 개선활동을 수행하는 학교 관련 단체 또는 시민단체를 청소년유해환경감시단 운영기관으로 지정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Private Monitoring and Reporting Organizations) ① The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head (referring to the head of an autonomous district) may designate a school-related organization or a civic group that carries out activities to improve the environment harmful to youth, in accordance with Article 48 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 40 of the Enforcement Decree, as an operating agency for the Youth Harmful Environment Monitoring Group.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제48조제2항에 따른 민간단체의 종류는 학교 관련 청소년유해환경감시단과 시민단체 청소년유해환경감시단으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The types of private organizations pursuant to Article 48, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be school-related youth harmful environment monitoring groups and civic group youth harmful environment monitoring groups.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(증표) 영 제40조에 따른 청소년유해환경감시단 운영기관 지정서는 별지 제11호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Certificate of Designation) The certificate of designation for the operating agency of the Youth Harmful Environment Monitoring Group pursuant to Article 40 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 11 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(과징금의 징수절차) 영 제45조제5항에 따른 과징금의 징수절차에 관하여는 「국고금 관리법 시행규칙」을 준용한다. 이 경우 납입고지서에는 이의신청의 방법 및 기간을 함께 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Procedures for Collection of Surcharges) The Enforcement Rules of the National Treasury Management Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the procedures for collection of surcharges pursuant to Article 45, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree. In this case, the method and period for filing an objection must be stated together on the notice of payment.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(과징금 납부기한의 연장 또는 분할납부의 신청 등) ① 영 제46조제1항에 따른 과징금 납부기한의 연장 또는 분할납부의 신청은 별지 제12호서식의 과징금 납부기한 연장 신청서 또는 별지 제13호서식의 과징금 분할납부 신청서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Application for Extension of Payment Deadline or Installment Payment of Surcharge, etc.) ①An application for extension of the payment deadline or installment payment of a surcharge pursuant to Article 46 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made using the Application for Extension of Payment Deadline of Surcharge in Form No. 12 of the Appendix or the Application for Installment Payment of Surcharge in Form No. 13 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제46조제2항에 따른 과징금 납부기한의 연장 또는 분할납부의 허용 여부에 대한 통지는 별지 제14호서식의 과징금 납부기한 연장 허용 통지서 또는 별지 제15호서식의 과징금 분할납부 허용 통지서에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② Notification regarding whether to extend the deadline for payment of a penalty surcharge or allow installment payment pursuant to Article 46 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the Notice of Permission to Extend the Deadline for Payment of Penalty Surcharge in Form No. 14 or the Notice of Permission to Allow Installment Payment of Penalty Surcharge in Form No. 15 .
ADDENDA <Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Decree No. 34, Sep. 14, 2012>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on September 16, 2012.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 청소년활동진흥법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rule of the Youth Activities Promotion Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제14조제2항 중 “「청소년보호법」 제2조제5호의 규정에 의한”을 “「청소년 보호법」 제2조제5호에 따른”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 14, Paragraph 2, “pursuant to the provisions of Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Youth Protection Act” shall be changed to “pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 5 of the Youth Protection Act”.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Decree No. 37, Mar. 23, 2013> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 and 3  omitted

rows.source_ko: 제4조(다른 법령의 개정) 청소년 보호법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Youth Protection Act is amended as follows.

In Item 2 of Annex 1, “Ministry of Education, Science and Technology, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Public Administration and Security” shall be changed to “Ministry of Science, ICT and Future Planning, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Security and Public Administration”.

In Item 1 of Annex 2, “Ministry of Education, Science and Technology” shall be changed to “Ministry of Education,” “Ministry of Public Administration and Security” to “Ministry of Safety and Security,” and “Korea Food and Drug Administration” to “Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.”
